description: Set or clear minWidth/maxWidth/minHeight/maxHeight: a number sets, null clears, omit leaves it. Applies to auto-layout frames and their direct children (others get a warning). Verified by readback (LIMIT_NOT_APPLIED / LIMIT_NOT_CLEARED). A variable-bound field keeps its bound value; unbind with figma_unbind_variable.
name: figma_set_size_limits
